items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: I think it was Reverend Dennis had that church on Arlene Street across from the project.

ctx.x: And I can remember when I was really young because my family was Catholic and Baptist. Father's side was Baptist. Mother's side was Catholic. And my daddy was a convert to the Catholic religion. Okay. But my aunt, who raised him, she was a staunch gospel singer at this church. I think it was Reverend Dennis had that church on Arlene Street across from the project. And she was a lead singer. She organized a choir and all that. And I remember her telling me when I was really younger because I would be playing Ritim…
